overall_summary: Analysis of historical performance shows clear outperformance in husband-wife relationship dynamics and domestic life realities (e.g., 'Shaadi Ke Baad Pyaar Kahan Chala Gaya?' at 1766 views and 'पत्नी की ये बात' at 1674 views). Broader concepts or standalone poetry with generic sad hooks underperform significantly. We have enough signals to pivot toward couple dynamics while keeping exploration minimal.

winning_patterns.evidence: Videos focusing on post-marriage love and partner understanding (or5gtaBpRVY, my5mP9feI7s) achieved the highest views (1,600+) and engagement on the channel.
winning_patterns.action: Prioritize narrative concepts centered around married life, unspoken expectations, and emotional distance between partners.

winning_patterns.evidence: Grounded family or relationship topics perform better than abstract or overly dramatic poetry (e.g., YdWh4cDOE64 with 14 views).
winning_patterns.action: Use specific, everyday household moments as the starting point for emotional storytelling.

weak_patterns.pattern: Abstract Sad Shayari & Heavy Philosophical Hooks
weak_patterns.evidence: Videos like 'जिस दिन सच लिखूंगा… रिश्तों को षड्यंत्र लिखूंगा' (YdWh4cDOE64) got only 14 views, showing poor initial pull.
weak_patterns.action: Avoid heavy, cryptic poetry openings; ground the hook in a recognizable, real-world situation instead.

weak_patterns.evidence: Clips framed with broad podcast terminology without a direct emotional anchor in the first 2 seconds underperformed compared to direct relationship themes.
weak_patterns.action: Ensure the core emotional conflict is immediately apparent in the title and opening line.
